versions.content: Compatibility of VariableDataPrototype typed by prim- itive data type of category VALUE in a PPortPrototype and a SystemSig- nal to which the VariableDataPrototype is mapped by SenderReceiver- ToSignalMapping If a VariableDataPrototype typed by an Application- PrimitiveDataType of category VALUE in a PPortPrototype is mapped by a SenderReceiverToSignalMapping to a SystemSignal then the following condi- tions shall be fulfilled by the VariableDataPrototype and the SystemSignal : • the dataConstr s of AutosarDataType.swDataDefProps defined on Ap- plicationDataType of the VariableDataPrototype are compatible to the dataConstr s of SystemSignal.physicalProps according to [con- str_9373]. • the compuMethod s of AutosarDataType.swDataDefProps defined on ApplicationDataType of the VariableDataPrototype is compatible to the compuMethod of SystemSignal.physicalProps according to [con- str_9372]. • the unit s of AutosarDataType.swDataDefProps defined on Applica- tionDataType of the VariableDataPrototype is compatible to the unit s of SystemSignal.physicalProps according to [constr_1052] defined in [4].
